description.ja: Figure-rise Standard 伝説の超サイヤ人ブロリーがパッケージをリニューアルして登場！！
description.en: Figure-rise Standard The legendary Super Saiyan Broly is now available with a new package! !

description.ja: • マッスルビルドシステムがパワーアップ！ブロリーの強靭な筋肉を徹底造形！筋肉のボリューム感は圧巻！
description.en: • Muscle build system is powered up! Broly's strong muscles are thoroughly sculpted! The volume of the muscles is amazing!

description.ja: • 筋肉に加え、関節周りのパーツ割にこだわり、より自然なポージングが可能に！
description.en: • In addition to the muscles, the parts around the joints have been carefully selected to allow for more natural poses!

description.ja: • 他のキャラクターと組み合わせて遊びの幅を広げる新パーツ「ドラマティックパーツ」が付属！圧倒的パワーに苦しむ悟空とベジータのダメージ顔で、劇中の戦闘シーンが再現可能に！
description.en: • New parts "Dramatic Parts" are included to expand the range of play by combining with other characters! You can now recreate the battle scenes from the movie with the damaged faces of Goku and Vegeta suffering from overwhelming power!

description.ja: • 表情パーツは、「平常」と「叫び」の2種類が付属！ブロリー特有の不気味で凶悪な表情を再現！
description.en: • Two types of facial expression parts are included: "normal " and " screaming"! Reproduce Broly's unique creepy and brutal expression!

accessories.ja: 表情パーツ2種（平常、叫び）×各1
accessories.en: 2 types of facial expression parts (normal, screaming) x 1 each
